expectations.text: Evaluates the codebase architecture BEFORE proposing a structure
expectations.evidence: Entire 'Step 0: Evaluate Architecture' section walks through decision tree questions Q1-Q3 before proposing anything

expectations.text: Does NOT prescribe a generic layered architecture with model/service/transport as primary grouping
expectations.evidence: Verdict is 'Pattern A — Domain Components'. No model/service/io layering proposed. Types live in image/, registry/, etc.

expectations.text: Proposes grouping by domain responsibility or pipeline phase
expectations.evidence: Proposes image/, registry/, cache/, ops/, cli/, infra/ — all named by domain responsibility

expectations.text: Identifies that types like digest, platform, layer belong with their domain, not a catch-all types/ or model/
expectations.evidence: digest.rs → image/digest.rs, platform.rs → image/platform.rs. Explicitly says 'Digest type is part of the image data model, not a standalone utility'

expectations.text: Mentions keeping lib.rs skeletal with fewer top-level declarations
expectations.evidence: Shows lib.rs with 6 declarations: image, registry, cache, ops, cli, infra. States 'Flat mod declarations only — no logic, no re-exports'
